verdict.rationale: Railway's marketing states 'Run your application closer to where your users are' (docs-7), implying region selection for latency, but there is no evidence of automatic compute placement decisions based on backend data location, no documentation of an algorithm or feature that colocates compute with data stores. missing for 10: technical detail on automatic placement logic, evidence of data-aware region selection, and any independent corroboration of latency optimization near data.
